✔️ What's the total price, with the radiologist's reading?

✔️ Is that with or without contrast?
✔️ Can I get a Good Faith Estimate in writing? (If you're uninsured or paying yourself, the No Surprises Act gives you that right.)

Before you book, ask for the total price with the radiologist's reading, whether there's a separate facility fee, and whether the price is with or without contrast. If you're uninsured or paying yourself, you have the right to a Good Faith Estimate in writing under the No Surprises Act. Using insurance? Ask how much of your deductible is left and compare it with the self-pay price. At Advanced Medical Imaging in Seminole and St. Petersburg, a self-pay MRI is $295 ($395 with and without contrast), radiologist's reading included, with no facility fees and no referral needed for self-pay. A typical Florida hospital self-pay MRI is $1,200 to $3,500. HSA/FSA and insurance accepted.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.

facts_checked: Checked 2026-10-31. CMS No Surprises Act: uninsured or self-pay individuals have the right to a Good Faith Estimate (on request, or when scheduled at least 3 business days ahead); CMS 'Key responsibilities for providers' and GFE patient-provider dispute resolution guidance. Practice facts from amiweb origin/main c8d18a4: prices.ts (mri $295, mriContrast $395, dexa $75, MRI at both centers); mri-cost-florida/page.tsx (typical FL hospital self-pay MRI $1,200-$3,500, DEXA $250-$600, 'representative, not a quote'; self-pay all-inclusive with radiologist reading, no facility fees or surprise bills; no referral for self-pay; HSA/FSA accepted; insurance needs physician's order); constants.ts phone and hours.
